proofs_summary: (I) c_hi = v_h d^2/sum d^2. (II) jitter delta*J of a two-point population in each stratum of A; shapes C(J_s) forced unbounded by equivariance (g: b=1/delta, a_h=-x_h/delta), pigeonhole over finitely many patterns; the partition of any population e' into the two clusters transfers the conclusion to every population; strict slack needed because jitter raises max-share to first order. Weak version: stabiliser of constant data forces C(D) to be dilation-invariant about t0, so covering theta != t0 forces a ray. (III) normalise to centred V=1, compact; a sequence of failing populations with c->inf must converge to e0 with SE=0 on a fixed failing set of mass > alpha, contradicting beta_st <= alpha. (IV) domination lemma: largest group M>=N/2 -> level (pi(N-M), a(N-M)) by Lemma 1 and superadditivity of C(.,n); M<N/2 -> (R_h, N_h) by convexity/greedy partition; also pi decreasing in k, R_h <= pi(floor(N/2)) by majorisation, so R is dominated for even N. (V) k* argument; DP knapsack. (VI)(b) closedness of the normalised class uses monotonicity at strata whose V_h tends to 0; levels as in (IV). Box: capacity needs >= ceil(1/v0) nonconstant strata, extra strata only lower the product, best level per stratum is pi_h(kmin_h) with kmin_h the smallest k<=N_h/2 with (N_h-k)(N_h-1)/(N_h k) <= Lambda0^2.
numerical_checks: (1) identity vs definition: 1476 random cases, 0 mismatches. (2) domination lemma: all partitions of N=4..10 x 2<=n<N = 793 triples, kappa_min by multistart SLSQP: 0 violations; pi monotone and R<=pi(floor(N/2)) in all N<=40 cases. (3) defeating populations for six configs (H=2,3; alpha 0.05..0.3): coverage of T+-cSE (c=1e2..1e6, delta<=1e-6) equals 1-prod pi (e.g. 0.7333<0.8, 0.8571<0.9, 0.6<0.7, 0.9286<0.95, 0.8333<0.9, 0.7755<0.8); coverage returns to 1 once c>>1/delta as expected; equality case: kappa_st=kappa0=0.138889 and P(SE=0)=0.2667>0.2. (4) adversarial search at kappa0=0.99/Cap_up (5 configs): worst c_needed found 9.6-13.6 (about 14 is the smallest c that worked everywhere in the search; provisional lower bound for the true sup), max P(SE=0) seen <= alpha; at 1.05/Cap_low c_needed=inf. (5) box class: 360/360 equal to exact beta for Lambda0>=2; Lambda0<2: two-point-only formula strictly below exact in 57/360, formula+R equal to exact in 360/360; attaining two-point population verified by full enumeration 100/100; 6997 random box-class populations never exceeded the formula. (6) (V)(c): own big-integer DP gives Cap in [2112.49, 2113.05], optimum k=1000 plus k=107, frontier 1/Cap=4.7325e-4, bracket [4.7325e-4, 4.7337e-4]; iid N(0,1) kappa_st over 20 draws mean 4.11e-4, min 3.04e-4, max 6.67e-4. Artifacts: verify_strat_report.md plus scripts strat_lib.py, check_levels_domination.py, check_II_defeat.py, check_III_adversarial.py, check_box_class.py, check_V.py and outputs.
deviations: A 2000-draw run of the iid N(0,1) kappa_st distribution (and an exact-Fraction recheck of pi(1000)pi(107)>0.1) was not run: the tool call was blocked by a safety check that could not run, and I did not retry by another route. The iid kappa_st figures therefore rest on only 20 draws (provisional); the DP already used exact integer binomials.
Adversarial worst-case c values (claim III) come from a time-limited random + hill-climb search (12 s per setting, 5 configs, H=2-3, N<=8) and are lower bounds on the true needed c, not proofs.

kappa_min(partition) for partitions with >=3 groups was found numerically (multistart SLSQP, N<=10); brute-force box/domination checks use sizes N<=10 (domination), N 4..8 (box) and H up to 5; (V)(a) scanned N<=40, n<N, alpha in {0.05,0.1,0.2,0.3} via the knapsack only.
Literature was not searched, as instructed; novelty is not assessed.
